_studyNote_root: The COMPONENT MANIFEST — the identity + contract of ONE Copilot Component. Remove _studyNote_* keys in a real scaffold. 'id' is a unique GUID; keep it stable across deploys.
_studyNote_componentType: componentType 'CopilotComponent' + copilotType 'Ux' = this renders UI inside the Copilot canvas (vs a headless/data component).
_studyNote_displayModes: THE 'OPEN A FULL APP' SWITCH. Declaring 'fullscreen' lets the component expand to the whole Copilot surface. Declare only what you actually support.
_studyNote_tools: Each tool is a capability the agent can invoke. 'name' must match a function in ai-plugin.json. 'propertiesSchema' points at the exported Zod schema describing the tool's parameters.

tools.name: greet
tools.description: Greet the user by name; optionally open full-screen.
